benefit: The canvas is an instrument: every prompt, job and frame answers the beat, and the finished storyboard lands on the drop.
proofAction: A typed prompt fires the canvas's generation node and routes signal along its wires to a queue node and a log node, a render countdown drains, and the finished storyboard strip node lands on the drop.
reference: Music-driven plate craft of the github.com/bizarro/evangelion treatment, taken as ideas only: one instrument per section, builds that accelerate and freeze, a hard drop, a break that stops. No palette, panel shape, type or imagery is reused.

assets.license: generated with Strudel (AGPL-3.0 tool, not bundled); built-in synth sounds only, no samples

cues.note: sawtooth pad opens bar 1 under the typing
bar 2: kick, clap and hats enter together
bar 6: snare roll on eighths, then sixteenths in bar 7, last beat silent
bar 8: full drums and bass land on the downbeat
bar 11: drums out, bass swell in two pulses, then two silent beats
bar 12: one square stab as the logo resolves
the stab rings out to the end

beats.subject: prompt node's log
beats.productAction: A prompt is typed into a canvas node, one phrase landing on each beat tick under the pad; an image node waits, unconnected, on the empty canvas

transformation.to: prompt node holding a four-line prompt

beats.note: Negative space on purpose: a dark, sparse plate whose only motion is the beat tick. Escalation begins at the groove.

beats.subject: generation node wired to a queue node and a log node
beats.productAction: The canvas renders as a node graph: the generation node's cells light on every kick and the prompt wire flashes with them, the clap routes a signal along the wire to the queue node, the hats along the wire to the log node

transformation.from: idle node graph: cells at rest, empty queue, empty log
transformation.to: generation node firing, queue loaded, jobs logged

beats.note: Dominant: the generation node. Three signal paths, each bound to a different sound (kick, clap, hats). Ground changes from dark navy to cream so the cut reads.

beats.subject: render queue node (ETA) wired to a depth node, with a render log node
beats.productAction: The render queue node drains toward zero: its ETA burns faster with every snare-roll hit while the depth node climbs on the pulse along its wire and the log node ticks the beat; the last beat holds still
beats.note: Escalation through rate (eighths then sixteenths), size (the pulse meter climbs) and colour (the countdown tints toward alert). The last beat is silent and still before the drop.

beats.subject: storyboard strip node fed by two throughput nodes
beats.productAction: On the drop the render finishes: the storyboard strip node shows four finished frames and takes the impact, a frame lights on every kick, and the clap and the bass send signal up the wires from two throughput nodes

transformation.from: render queue clear, strip not yet shown
transformation.to: strip node holding four finished frames

beats.note: Cut accent: the full impact (flash, zoom punch, shake) lands on the downbeat of bar 8. Ground changes from near-black to cobalt.

beats.subject: process trace node
beats.productAction: The finished render settles: two bass-swell pulses travel across the process trace node once and every column returns to rest, the node drifts, and the last 0.6 s holds still before the stab
beats.note: Negative space: drums are out, so the picture stops pumping without freezing (a slow drift and one travelling pulse). Ground changes to dark teal.

beats.subject: logo over the finished storyboard strip
beats.productAction: The logo resolves over the finished strip, four frames wide, on the closing stab
beats.note: Cut accent: a flash-only hold-then-hit (zoom 1, no shake) on the stab; the closing rule wipes in and ends the timeline at 24 s.
